CRWV.headline: Why Advanced Micro Devices Stock Popped Today
CRWV.description: AMD stock surged 8.43% following CoreWeave's strong Q3 earnings beat and raised guidance for 2026, signaling increased capital spending on semiconductor chips. Additionally, a UBS report highlighted that server CPU shipments jumped 31% year-over-year in Q3, with AMD maintaining steady market share at 28.4% while Intel declined. UBS projects CPU sales could reach $210 billion by 2030, potentially generating $60 billion in revenue for AMD alone.

CRWV.headline: CoreWeave Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Funding and Margin Gains
CRWV.description: CoreWeave (CRWV) raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $13-$13.3B following Q3 revenues of $3.66B that beat consensus estimates. The company reported improved operating margins at 10%, expects $9B in customer prepayments over three months, and identified nearly $10B in potential annualized GPU renewal revenues from 2027-2028. Management emphasized pricing strength with 25-35% increases implemented and expects to achieve positive adjusted net income in H1 2028.

CRWV.headline: Why Micron Stock Popped Today
CRWV.description: Micron stock surged 11.46% following CoreWeave's strong Q3 earnings report. CoreWeave beat analyst expectations on revenue ($3.66B) and earnings, and raised full-year 2026 guidance to $13.0-13.3B in revenue. The company also announced $37-39B in capital investment spending, which will drive demand for Micron's memory chips used in data centers. CoreWeave's path to profitability by early 2028 suggests sustained future chip purchases.

CRWV.headline: Why Sandisk Stock Popped Today
CRWV.description: Sandisk stock surged 14.63% following CoreWeave's strong Q3 earnings report. CoreWeave, which builds AI data centers and purchases memory chips from Sandisk, beat analyst expectations on revenue and earnings while raising full-year 2026 guidance and committing $37-39 billion in capital investment. Analysts view Sandisk as undervalued at less than 7x trailing earnings and under 4x forward earnings.

However, the company faces significant debt challenges with $47 billion in total debt and Q4 interest expenses expected between $1.05-$1.15 billion, far exceeding Q3 adjusted operating income of $379 million. CRWV.description: CoreWeave is expanding its Nvidia-powered AI infrastructure with significant growth potential, having activated new capacity and extending its global data center network. However, the company faces substantial financial pressure with $51.6 billion in debt and deeply negative free cash flow, with only 1.5 gigawatts of its 4.2 gigawatts of contracted power currently active.

NBIS.headline: 1 Unstoppable AI Stock to Buy Hand Over Fist Before the Next Leg Higher
NBIS.description: Iren, an AI data center company, has crashed 70% from its all-time high despite strengthening fundamentals. The company's AI cloud revenue nearly tripled sequentially to $200M, megawatt pricing has more than doubled to $22-40M per megawatt (vs. $9.7M previously), and it has a $20.3B revenue backlog with $1B in operating annual recurring revenue. With a 35-gigawatt development pipeline and strong financing through prepayments, Iren appears undervalued at current levels.

NBIS.headline: Neoclouds Like Nebius Are Much Better Investments Than Colocation Companies Like TeraWulf. Here's Why.
NBIS.description: Neoclouds like Nebius command significantly higher megawatt pricing ($20-50M/MW) compared to colocation providers like TeraWulf ($2.4M/MW), enabling faster scaling and better profitability. Nebius benefits from lucrative long-term contracts, declining payback periods (now 1 year 10 months), and the ability to finance capex through prepayments and GPU collateral, positioning neoclouds as superior long-term investments despite higher initial costs.

NBIS.headline: Stock Market Today, Nov. 10: CoreWeave Stock Edges Lower as a Multibillion-Dollar Question Looms Over Earnings
NBIS.description: CoreWeave reported strong Q3 results with 168% year-over-year revenue growth to $3.66 billion and raised full-year guidance, but faces significant challenges with a $709 million net loss and $39 billion in expected capital expenditures. The key question for investors is whether the company can convert surging AI infrastructure demand into sustainable profits amid mounting debt and financing costs.

NBIS.headline: Massive News for CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital Stock Investors
NBIS.description: Recent developments are causing concern among investors in AI infrastructure stocks including CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, and Applied Digital. The article discusses how these companies are being impacted by recent market movements and investor sentiment shifts in the AI cloud and data center sector.

MPWR.headline: Here's How Much a $1000 Investment in Monolithic Power Made 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
MPWR.description: A $1,000 investment in Monolithic Power (MPWR) made in November 2016 would be worth $17,402.83 by November 2026, representing a 1,640.28% gain, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 249.01% return. The semiconductor company benefits from strong demand in AI, data centers, and communications infrastructure, though it faces risks from data-center spending dependence, competition, and premium valuation.
